description_en: Updates the Settings for the protection status of specified rules for HTTP DDoS attack prevention
description_zh: 设置HTTP DDoS攻击防护指定规则防护状态
name: SetHttpDDoSAttackRuleStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the site. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation.

The site must use the Enterprise Edition plan and pass the DDoS version check. Otherwise, the API returns the 403 SiteIdDDoSVersionCheckFailed error (DDoS version check failed for the site) or the 400 ErrSiteIdNoteEnterprise error (the site does not use the Enterprise Edition plan and cannot use this feature. Upgrade the site to the Enterprise Edition plan)
parameters.help_zh:
站点ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html接口获取。

站点需为企业版套餐并通过 DDoS 版本校验，否则接口返回 403 SiteIdDDoSVersionCheckFailed（站点对应 DDoS 版本检查失败）或 400 ErrSiteIdNoteEnterprise（当前站点非企业版套餐，无法使用该功能，请升级站点为企业版套餐）
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the rules to be managed. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
You can call the [DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~) operation to obtain the rule IDs
parameters.help_zh:
需要操作的规则ID列表，多个ID用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用[DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules](~~DescribeHttpDDoSAttackRules~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: rule_ids

parameters.help_en:
The status of the rule. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则状态

on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: status
